method: Systematic amplitude sensitivity with Monte Carlo falsification; adversarial PCA/GP nuisance search; era×station×lunation grid; blind year hold-out

adversarial_gp.method: 2D binned elongation x time GP (Step 060-style bin means)

interpretation: Known systematics: to explain |eta|=4.06e-04 requires 0.53 cm; smallest ratio to a known systematic is 1.5x. Adversarial PCA (20 residual-ranked PCs): joint eta=-2.93e-04 (survival=True). GP elongation nuisance absorbs 83% of cos(D) amplitude (eta after subtraction=5.35e-05). Interaction grid: 13/26 fitted cells have negative eta; blind 20% year hold-out combined eta=-3.66e-04 (14.3σ). Modeled known-systematic-only MC falsification remains below observed |eta|. Unmodeled or data-driven nuisances are additionally stress-tested above.
